## Structs

### `audio_bank_t`

_Source: `lib/audio/audio.h`_

```cpp
typedef struct{
    audio_i2s_bank_t bank;
    audio_i2s_direction_t ad;
    audio_i2s_ch_t ch;
    int8_t data_rx;
    int8_t data_tx;
}audio_bank_t;
```

Audio bank description. A bank is a stereo block.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `bank` | Bank number. Is either audio_i2s_bank_a or audio_i2s_bank_b. |
| `ad` | Audio direction. See audio_i2s_direction_t. |
| `ch` | Channel config. Is either audio_i2s_ch_mono or audio_i2s_ch_stereo. |
| `data_rx` | Audio data in pin number for bank. Set to -1 if output only. |
| `data_tx` | Audio data out pin number for bank. Set to -1 if input only. |

### `audio_io_t`

_Source: `lib/audio/audio_types.h`_

```cpp
typedef struct{
    audio_sample_t* in;
    audio_sample_t* out;
    uint32_t len;
    uint8_t nch;
}audio_io_t;
```

Audio data IO struct. Represents the audio callback interface and reusable block-DSP data seam.

> **Note:** If only input or only output is configured, the other pointer is NULL.

### `audio_meta_t`

_Source: `lib/audio/audio.h`_

```cpp
typedef struct {
    audio_sample_t audio_buf[AUDIO_PINGPONG_SAMPLES*2];
    QueueSetHandle_t audio_evt_qset;
    QueueHandle_t audio_evt_qlist[audio_i2s_bank_N + 1];
    audio_settings_t settings;
    audio_bank_t banks[audio_i2s_bank_N];
    audio_cb_t cb;
    uint8_t __num_banks;
    volatile uint8_t sampler_suspended;
    #ifdef AUDIO_TIMING_ENABLE
    audio_timing_state_t timing;
    #endif
} audio_meta_t;
```

Audio meta descriptor. Holds buffer, event queue, global settings and banks.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `audio_buf` | Audio data buffer. Size is sizeof(audio_sample_t) * AUDIO_PINGPONG_SAMPLES * 2. |
| `audio_evt_qset` | FreeRTOS queue set for unified queue access. |
| `audio_evt_qlist` | Array of queues. The last element is the control queue. |
| `settings` | Global audio settings instance. |
| `banks` | Array of bank descriptors holding hardware parameters. |
| `__num_banks` | Runtime defined bank count. Can't be more than audio_i2s_bank_N, but can be less. |
| `sampler_suspended` | State of sampler. |

### `audio_settings_t`

_Source: `lib/audio/audio.h`_

```cpp
typedef struct{
    uint32_t sr;
    uint8_t bps;
    int8_t bclk;
    int8_t ws;
    audio_val_base_t gain;
}audio_settings_t;
```

Global audio settings shared by all banks.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `sr` | Sampling rate. |
| `bps` | Bit depth. |
| `bclk` | Shared bitclock pin number. |
| `ws` | Shared word select pin number. |
| `gain` | Linear output gain applied by the internal audio callback. 0 mutes, 1 is neutral. |

## Unions

### `audio_sample_t`

_Source: `lib/audio/audio_types.h`_

```cpp
typedef union {
    struct {
        audio_sample_base_t ch1;
        #if AUDIO_MAX_NUM_CH > 1
        audio_sample_base_t ch2;
        #endif
        #if AUDIO_MAX_NUM_CH > 2
        audio_sample_base_t ch3;
        #endif
        #if AUDIO_MAX_NUM_CH > 3
        audio_sample_base_t ch4;
        #endif
    }_chx;
    audio_sample_base_t ch[AUDIO_MAX_NUM_CH];
}audio_sample_t;
```

Shared sample description in time. All channels run in parallel.

> **Note:** Amount of possible channels set by `AUDIO_MAX_NUM_CH`, but the runtime can use less than that if wanted.

### `audio_val_t`

_Source: `lib/audio/audio_types.h`_

```cpp
typedef union {
    struct {
        audio_val_base_t ch1;
        #if AUDIO_MAX_NUM_CH > 1
        audio_val_base_t ch2;
        #endif
        #if AUDIO_MAX_NUM_CH > 2
        audio_val_base_t ch3;
        #endif
        #if AUDIO_MAX_NUM_CH > 3
        audio_val_base_t ch4;
        #endif
    }_chx;
    audio_val_base_t ch[AUDIO_MAX_NUM_CH];
}audio_val_t;
```

Arbitrary DSP value description in time. All channels run in parallel.

> **Note:** Amount of possible channels set by `AUDIO_MAX_NUM_CH`, but the runtime can use less than that if wanted.

## Enums

### `audio_i2s_bank_t`

_Source: `lib/audio/audio.h`_

```cpp
typedef enum{
    audio_i2s_bank_a,
    #if AUDIO_MAX_NUM_CH>2
    audio_i2s_bank_b,
    #endif
    audio_i2s_bank_N,
    audio_ctrl_queue_idx = audio_i2s_bank_N
}audio_i2s_bank_t;
```

Audio bank enumeration. The ESP32 has 2 stereo banks, meaning 4 IO channels.

> **Note:** The control queue enumeration is included, so that the audio meta type can hold all queues of the system in one queue array. To not break semantics, the amount of banks and the index for the control queue have the same number. As seen in audio_meta_t, the field audio_evt_qlist ist an array of length audio_i2s_bank_N + 1.

### `audio_i2s_ch_t`

_Source: `lib/audio/audio.h`_

```cpp
typedef enum{
    audio_i2s_ch_mono = (i2s_channel_fmt_t)I2S_CHANNEL_FMT_ONLY_LEFT,
    audio_i2s_ch_stereo = (i2s_channel_fmt_t)I2S_CHANNEL_FMT_RIGHT_LEFT
}audio_i2s_ch_t;
```

Audio data channel naming

> **Note:** Maps "left" to mono and "left/right" to stereo on a bank.

### `audio_i2s_direction_t`

_Source: `lib/audio/audio.h`_

```cpp
typedef enum{
    audio_i2s_bank_host_i = (i2s_mode_t)I2S_MODE_MASTER | I2S_MODE_RX,
    audio_i2s_bank_host_o = (i2s_mode_t)I2S_MODE_MASTER | I2S_MODE_TX,
    audio_i2s_bank_host_io = (i2s_mode_t)I2S_MODE_MASTER | I2S_MODE_TX | I2S_MODE_RX,
    audio_i2s_bank_HOST_NUM,
    audio_i2s_bank_devi_i = (i2s_mode_t)I2S_MODE_SLAVE | I2S_MODE_RX,
    audio_i2s_bank_devi_o = (i2s_mode_t)I2S_MODE_SLAVE | I2S_MODE_TX,
    audio_i2s_bank_devi_io = (i2s_mode_t)I2S_MODE_SLAVE | I2S_MODE_TX | I2S_MODE_RX,
    audio_i2s_bank_DEVI_NUM
}audio_i2s_direction_t;
```

"i" means input, "o" means output

> **Note:** "host" means "master", "devi" means slave

### `i2s_event_type_ext_t`

_Source: `lib/audio/audio.h`_

```cpp
typedef enum{
    AUDIO_CTRL_EVT_STOP = I2S_EVENT_MAX + 1,     /// Stop audio streaming
    AUDIO_CTRL_EVT_RESTART,                      /// Restart audio streaming
    AUDIO_CTRL_EVT_SUSPEND,
    AUDIO_CTRL_EVT_SET_CALLBACK                  /// Set new audio callback (via event queue data field)
}i2s_event_type_ext_t;
```

Extended I2S event types for libFRX audio module

> **Note:** These extend ESP-IDF's I2S events (I2S_EVENT_MAX + 1 and above)

### `audio_sampler`

_Source: `lib/audio/audio.h`_

```cpp
void audio_sampler(void* p);
```

Manages the queue ISR for audio I/O.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `p` | Pointer to job parameters. |

> **Note:** If more than one bank is configured, the second one is chained to the first (devi-config). Since they become synchronised that way, the second peripheral event is not needed. The sampler assumes that the completion of an audio IO block on bank A means that bank B is finished as well, which is why only the event of bank A is considered.

### `audio_set_callback`

_Source: `lib/audio/audio.h`_

```cpp
e_syserr_t audio_set_callback(audio_cb_t cb);
```

Set the audio callback function.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `cb` | Function pointer to invoke with audio buffer on each frame. Callback signature: void cb(audio_sample_t* buffer) |

**Returns:** Error code (e_syserr_none on success, e_syserr_driver_fail if queue full)

> **Note:** Callback change takes effect on next I2S event. Uses queue for thread-safe update.

### `audio_set_gain`

_Source: `lib/audio/audio.h`_

Set linear output gain. Values are clipped to 0..1.

|---|---|
| `gain` | Linear gain. 0 mutes, 1 is neutral. |

**Returns:** e_syserr_none.
